paragraphs.en: Marques Brownlee just released a video essay titled “Dear YouTube” .
paragraphs.zh: Marques Brownlee 刚刚发布了一部名为《Dear YouTube》的视频短论。

paragraphs.en: He talks about how YouTube is going to start shipping this new feature where makers can essentially publish different “variants” of their videos and see which performs best (an A/B test).
paragraphs.zh: 他谈到 YouTube 将如何开始推出一项新功能，让创作者可以为其视频发布不同的“变体”，并查看哪个效果最好（即 A/B 测试）。

paragraphs.en: Which immediately begs a lot of questions. Brownlee voices his:
paragraphs.zh: 这立刻引出了许多问题。布朗利（Brownlee）说出了他的疑问：

paragraphs.en: It’s pretty wild when you think about it. I mean, imagine sending someone a link, “Check out this cool video!” And at that point you’re basically crossing your fingers, “I hope they see the same thing I did…”
paragraphs.zh: 仔细想想，这其实挺疯狂的。 我是说，想象一下你给某个人发一个链接，“看看这个超酷的视频！”而那一刻你基本上就是在双手合十祈祷：“希望他们看到的是和我一样的东西……”

sents.en: It’s pretty wild when you think about it.
sents.zh: 仔细想想，这其实挺疯狂的。

sents.en: I mean, imagine sending someone a link, “Check out this cool video!” And at that point you’re basically crossing your fingers, “I hope they see the same thing I did…”
sents.zh: 我是说，想象一下你给某个人发一个链接，“看看这个超酷的视频！”而那一刻你基本上就是在双手合十祈祷：“希望他们看到的是和我一样的东西……”

paragraphs.en: Marques says he spoke to some YouTube engineers about these questions and they didn’t really have answers. They were kind of just like, “We don’t know — yolo! This’ll ship soon.”
paragraphs.zh: 马尔克斯说，他曾就这些问题与一些 YouTube 工程师交谈过，但他们其实也没有答案。 他们大致就是那种态度：“我们不知道——随缘吧！这功能很快就会上线。”

sents.en: Marques says he spoke to some YouTube engineers about these questions and they didn’t really have answers.
sents.zh: 马尔克斯说，他曾就这些问题与一些 YouTube 工程师交谈过，但他们其实也没有答案。

sents.en: They were kind of just like, “We don’t know — yolo! This’ll ship soon.”
sents.zh: 他们大致就是那种态度：“我们不知道——随缘吧！这功能很快就会上线。”

paragraphs.en: So his video is a kind of plea to YouTube creators everywhere: Don’t use this feature!
paragraphs.zh: 所以他的视频实际上是在向所有 YouTube 创作者发出一种呼吁：不要使用这个功能！

paragraphs.en: There’s this sort of unspoken rule of community on YouTube, that like we’re all having this same experience together — we’re all watching the same video. That is what makes it a cultural phenomenon is that we all saw the same thing […] so letting people put up two or three different videos of the same thing at the same time kind of fundamentally breaks that, which doesn't feel right.
paragraphs.zh: YouTube 上存在一种默契的社区规则，就好像我们都在共同经历同一件事——我们都在观看同一个视频。 正因为我们都看到了同样的东西，它才成为一种文化现象……所以允许人们同时观看同一个事物的两三个不同视频，从根本上破坏了这一点，这感觉不对劲。

sents.en: There’s this sort of unspoken rule of community on YouTube, that like we’re all having this same experience together — we’re all watching the same video.
sents.zh: YouTube 上存在一种默契的社区规则，就好像我们都在共同经历同一件事——我们都在观看同一个视频。

sents.en: That is what makes it a cultural phenomenon is that we all saw the same thing […] so letting people put up two or three different videos of the same thing at the same time kind of fundamentally breaks that, which doesn't feel right.
sents.zh: 正因为我们都看到了同样的东西，它才成为一种文化现象……所以允许人们同时观看同一个事物的两三个不同视频，从根本上破坏了这一点，这感觉不对劲。

paragraphs.en: Brownlee goes on to make a lot of great points in the video that, I think, can be applicable to making software as well. A few that stood out:
paragraphs.zh: Brownlee 在视频中接着提出了许多很好的观点，我认为这些观点同样适用于软件开发。以下是几个令我印象深刻的：

paragraphs.en: I find it interesting how Brownlee shares his opinion that YouTube spends way too much time chasing their competitors and not enough time being YouTube.
paragraphs.zh: 我觉得很有意思的是，Brownlee 分享了他的看法：YouTube 花了太多时间追逐竞争对手，而没有足够的时间做好自己作为 YouTube 的本分。

paragraphs.en: Which, when you think about it, is exactly the kind of place a feature like this would stem from: an insecurity in your own creative choices. How YouTube approaches its own insecurities is now trickling down as a feature to its users.
paragraphs.zh: 仔细想想，这恰恰是这类功能的来源之地：对自身创作选择的不安全感。 YouTube 应对自身不安全感的方式，如今正作为一个功能下放给它的用户。

sents.en: Which, when you think about it, is exactly the kind of place a feature like this would stem from: an insecurity in your own creative choices.
sents.zh: 仔细想想，这恰恰是这类功能的来源之地：对自身创作选择的不安全感。

sents.en: How YouTube approaches its own insecurities is now trickling down as a feature to its users.
sents.zh: YouTube 应对自身不安全感的方式，如今正作为一个功能下放给它的用户。

paragraphs.en: “Let’s let people make lots of variations on things, try all of them, and see what performs best” is exactly the kind of thinking you get in a platform that doesn’t know what it wants to be. So it’s left spending its time 1) doing what others are doing, and 2) following the fickle whims of whatever it can measure .
paragraphs.zh: “让人们大量制作各种变体，全部尝试一遍，看看哪种效果最好”——这种思维方式恰恰出现在一个不知道自己想成为什么的平台上。 于是它只剩下把时间花在两件事上：1）做别人都在做的事，2）追随它能衡量到的那些善变的念头。

sents.en: “Let’s let people make lots of variations on things, try all of them, and see what performs best” is exactly the kind of thinking you get in a platform that doesn’t know what it wants to be.
sents.zh: “让人们大量制作各种变体，全部尝试一遍，看看哪种效果最好”——这种思维方式恰恰出现在一个不知道自己想成为什么的平台上。

sents.en: So it’s left spending its time 1) doing what others are doing, and 2) following the fickle whims of whatever it can measure .
sents.zh: 于是它只剩下把时间花在两件事上：1）做别人都在做的事，2）追随它能衡量到的那些善变的念头。

paragraphs.en: It’s like this adolescent attitude of, “I don’t know what I want to be, so I’m gonna imitate my peers and let others tell me what they think I should be.”
paragraphs.zh: 这就好比那种青春期的心态：“我不知道自己想成为什么，所以我要模仿我的同伴，让别人告诉我他们认为我应该成为什么。”

paragraphs.en: Anyway, that’s a long way of saying I liked the video. You might too. Hopefully you see the same thing I did, lol.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，说了这么多其实就是想表达我很喜欢这个视频，你也许会喜欢。 希望你看到的和我看到的一样，哈哈。
